description: Scores of yesterday, today and tomorrow in the real leagues: live games with their clock, finished games and upcoming games. Useful to follow your matches or decide predictions. Each match has eventId (the same one get_pool returns). An unknown league key is rejected with UNKNOWN_LEAGUE.

league.description: optional: same as leagues (one key or several separated by commas)

leagues.description: optional: list_leagues keys separated by commas (default: all)

status.description: optional: only live, finished or upcoming games

name: get_scoreboard
title: Get scoreboard
